resources.string: Registry Coach monitors which apps you use to help you be more aware of your screen time and find better tools in your registry. It reads on-screen content momentarily to understand what kind of task you\'re doing. Nothing is stored, recorded, or sent anywhere.
Registry Coach monitors which apps you use to help you be more aware of your screen time and find better tools in your registry.
It reads on-screen content momentarily to understand what kind of task you\'re doing. This data is processed on your device only and is never saved.
Nothing is stored, recorded, or sent anywhere — ever.
Registry Coach is monitoring your app usage
Registry Coach requires on-device AI capabilities that are not available on this device.
